Definition: from G3152; inutility; figuratively, transientness; morally, depravity:--vanity.
BiblicalUsage: Vanity is the emptiness and fading of everything that does not last. Paul says the whole creation was made subject to vanity, and he warns believers not to walk as the Gentiles do, in the vanity of their minds. Peter describes false teachers who speak great swelling words of vanity and lure the unstable back into sin.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that vanity is the Bible's word for the hollowness of life apart from God: the world promises fullness and gives only wind. But creation was subjected to vanity in hope, and that hope is the gospel — God will fill what is empty.
